work.title: Buy Me (Chess)
work.description: Dense mixed-media collage dated 3/7/12 incorporates chess pieces, archery targets, a football, and handwritten text reading "BUY ME" across a layered ground of torn paper, yellow tape, and painted marks. Red cross motifs, concentric-ring bullseyes, and black ink outlines accumulate across a white-dominant surface framed in black.
work.composition: dense layered accumulation across horizontal plane
keywords: yellow tape cross marks layered collage
